verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing ships its own background automations: automatic advancement and collection that sends overdue reminders and retries failed payments, automatic cash reconciliation, and automatic charging of the payment method on file. These are fixed, built-in behaviors you configure. There is no evidence of user-defined automation rules or agent-driven autonomous workflows; the API, webhooks and MCP server are only building blocks for constructing them. missing for 10: user-configurable custom automation/workflow builder, recurring or scheduled automation controls beyond dunning, independent or hands-on corroboration of background automation behavior

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: If the invoice becomes overdue, or payment on the invoice fails, Stripe can automatically send reminders or retry the payment for you.
Automatic reconciliation: Let Stripe handle cash reconciliation.
Automatically charge your customer's payment method on file
You can configure Stripe to send email notifications or reminders to your customer
